en.title: Semantic layer: the caching framework
en.shortdesc: Single-flight, canonical cache keys and manifest-versioned invalidation. How a semantic layer serves repeats for free without serving stale numbers.
en.longdesc: Part 5 of a series on building a semantic-layer report engine: the in-process result cache, canonical keys, single-flight coalescing, hit/miss/coalesced states, TTLs, deadlines, and why the manifest version makes a cached result correct by construction.
en.seoDescription: Caching semantic queries correctly: single-flight, canonical keys and manifest-versioned invalidation. Part 5 of a series on semantic-layer report engines.
